rejected_or_refuted.candidate_finding: concurrent estimate writes can double-commit (potential cross-user corruption)
rejected_or_refuted.reason: estimate_mutation_receipts UNIQUE(workspace_id, command_kind, intent_id) written in the same batch as the row mutation. Concurrent losers read the winner's receipt and replay. row_revision guard aborts stale writes. The idempotency surface is robust.
